text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Phew... As expected, there is so much to learn from Flash-senpai's training, desu!!
Is this the end of the menu, desu ka?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, all that's left is to return to the dorm and replenish protein... Oh, isn't that—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone~! Nature aplenty! Delicious food aplenty! Tomakomai is waiting for you all, ya know~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Maybe I should make the hand wave a bit smaller. That would bring out more cuteness and fit my chara—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Guten Tag, Tarumae-san.
Are you practicing something?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...!? F-Flash-san!
And El-san too!?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see, you are practicing for Tomakomai's PR event.
Putting in so much effort really shows how deeply you love your hometown, Tarumae-san.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (...If I can understand what others feel like I did back then, surely I can become closer to Tarumae-san and the others as well—)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Tarumae-san. If you wouldn't mind,
could you teach me more about Tomakomai?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El wants to know too, desu!
The nature, the delicious food—I'm super curious, de~su!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
!? R-Really!? By all means!!
Um, um, in that case, why don't you come over to my room!?
I have materials and merchandise about Tomakomai...!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wow! This scenery looks so magical, de~su!!
It's called Tarumae Garo, right!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yeah!! The moss looks like a velvet carpet, making it such a gorgeous ravine...!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I really like this Lake Utonai!
The water is so clear—
and there are so many swans and wild birds—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It somehow reminds me of my childhood.
I used to visit lakes quite often back then.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh! A German lake?
If it's okay with you, I'd love to hear more!
It might be useful for tourism PR ideas...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Well, during vacation season, my parents would close the shop and we would spend time at a lakeside lodge.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Reading books on a waterside lounge bed, rowing a canoe, gazing at the scenery and wild birds along the lakeshore from the water—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: The nights were very quiet, with the distant hooting of owls, and the sky filled with a full canopy of stars.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Wow... True to the word 'vacation,' that sounds like such a relaxing way to spend time!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of vacations in Mexico, it's all about the Caribbean! Blazing sun and Caribbean-blue sea, desu!
According to Papa, on vacations—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —So, to create a new souvenir for Tomakomai, I've been collaborating with local businesses to develop sweets made from haskap berries!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: This is the haskap jam used in the sweets, so please feel free to try some if you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Danke schön. Then next time, I shall make some sweets using this jam and bring them over.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: My parents bake cakes using local specialty ingredients. I will try coming up with a recipe based on their methods.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ehh!? That's amazing, Flash-san!
Um, in that case, would you please let me bake it with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking through the academy, I came across Eishin Flash and the others happily gathered around a cake.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the presentation passes inspection!
It is well-proportioned and vividly colored.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yeah! This looks totally Umastagrammable!
choice_data_list: Did you all bake a cake together?
Did everyone make a cake together?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. We baked a tart using the haskap jam given to us by Tarumae-san.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now then! Let's do a taste test right away, desu!
Itadakimasu~~!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this turned out well.
The acidity of the haskap is refreshing, making it very easy to eat.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Delicious!! This is definitely going to become a hot topic!
I'll share the recipe with the confectionery company right away—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Screeech!! *Flap flap*)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: !? M-Ma—Goodness...! Perching on my shoulder, what an, u-um, friendly condor-san you are, ahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, could this bird be interested in the tart as well?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The three enjoyed their cake together amicably. And perched on El Condor Pasa's shoulder, the hawk seemed to watch over them with gentle eyes.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, fairly decent. If we increase the haskap by roughly 3% more, the flavor—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Screeech! *Flap flap!*)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Mambo!? Ah, no... c-condor-san!
S-Stop it, desu! You can't eat that!!
Ah, waaaait, de~su!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
! E-El-san, please wait!
There is still plenty left, you don't have to chase after it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Clutching the tart in its beak, the hawk circled pleasantly high in the sky, as if looking down over the three of them.
